track.title: Brain Implant (Cyberpunk Sci-Fi Trailer Action Intro)

tempo.note: Bars numbered from 0 at 0.60 s. Every structural event lands on a downbeat: bar n starts at 0.60+2.4n s.

sections.name: intro_impact_drone
sections.desc: Opening boom ~0.5 s, then decaying dark drone/low sweep (no rhythm).

sections.name: intro_build
sections.desc: Second impact at 5.40, rhythmic pulse enters, rising filter sweep 7.0-9.5 (riser).

sections.name: pause_1
sections.desc: Short near-silent gap (~-30 dB) before re-entry.

sections.name: part_A_groove
sections.desc: Main intro groove: 16th-note pulse with sweeps; bass hits.

sections.name: freeze
sections.desc: Rhythm stops; sustained sound filter-sweeps down (centroid ~2.7 kHz -> ~0.5 kHz at 21.5 s). Not silence: level stays ~-7 dB.

sections.name: drop_part_B
sections.desc: Full-energy industrial section; 8 bars, densest onsets.

sections.name: final_slowdown
sections.desc: Rhythm stops after 41.31; filter sweeps down to ~0.5 kHz at 43.0, brief dip at 43.5 (wind-up).

sections.name: final_thump_tail
sections.desc: Final thump then long decay; below -40 dB from ~46.6 s.

key_cues.name: opening_impact
key_cues.use: Rooftop reveal / sound starts after start button

key_cues.name: freeze_start
key_cues.use: Ground approaching; time-freeze / build to smash

key_cues.name: freeze_lowest_filter
key_cues.use: Deepest point of the freeze (max tension)

key_cues.name: drop
key_cues.use: GROUND SMASH-THROUGH: flash, explosion, video cut to mantle

key_cues.name: biggest_accent_in_drop
key_cues.use: Strongest transient in the track: big rock/cliff set-piece

key_cues.name: final_slowdown_start
key_cues.use: Start camera swoop to side view; world slow-motion

key_cues.name: tail_quiet
key_cues.use: Hand over to serene core ambience (crossfade)

obstacle_hit_candidates.note: Strongest full-band and bass-band onset peaks; snap to the 16th grid (0.15 s) for spawn timing.

shunts.note: v06b (Oct 2026): re-identified from the audio (20 ms energy envelope + low-band / broadband rise detection on the mp3). The three big hits are the opening impact and the next two full-level impacts; everything in between (pulse, riser 7.0-9.5, snare at 9.5) is much weaker. Times are the attack (level within 10 dB of the hit's peak); all three sit on the 100 bpm downbeat grid (bars 0, 2, 4). shunt 1 = 0.59 s attack (peak -3 dBFS, up from silence), shunt 2 = 5.40 s (peak -2.7 dBFS, +21 dB over the bar before), shunt 3 = 10.19 s (peak -1.0 dBFS, out of the -36 dB pause). The old 7.80 'shunt' is only a pulse/riser accent (peak -9.5 dBFS, no transient). Edit the t values and re-run build_blockout_v06.py.

shunt_1_open.use: Black screen cuts to the close-up on his face (he faces out over the void, camera in front of him). He stays mostly still (breathing) until halfway to shunt 2, then prepares to jump while the camera moves straight back.

shunt_2_jump.use: Jump out over the void into a backflip and tuck; apex slow motion (v06.apex_slowmo). The camera follows him up through the arc.

shunt_3_dive.use: He opens into the dive; the camera dives after him, then twists round into the falling follow. Normal speed (same hit as reentry_impact).

shunts_v06_old.note: SUPERSEDED (v05/v06 numbering, 5.40 / 7.80 / 10.10). Kept for reference only; the build reads 'shunts'. v05: the three opening 'shunts' (Ian's numbering). Edit the t values and re-run build_blockout.py to retime the jump, descent and skydive spread. shunt_3 is the same hit as reentry_impact (the existing 'fall speeds up' shunt). Analysis (librosa, sub<120 Hz peak / rise vs 0.3 s before): 5.40 = 58 dB (+35), 7.80 = 48 dB (+10), 9.50 = 31 dB sub but strongest broadband onset (snare-like), 10.10-10.24 = 58 dB (+38). Alternatives for shunt_2 are listed.

shunt_1_jump.use: Jump up/out in an arc (diving board), backflip + pirouette into a tuck. Camera side-on (horizon/sun behind him).

shunt_2_descent.use: Descent proper starts, still tucked. Camera cuts to the downward bird's-eye follow.

shunt_3_spread.use: Snap out of the ball into the skydive spread; fall speeds up (same hit as reentry_impact).

bullet_time.note: v05: wind-down before the smash. World + character run on a remapped clock (rate) while the camera stays real-time. Rate eases 1 -> min between start and settle, holds, then snaps back to 1 at the drop.

v06.note: v06 (Oct 2026): black until shunt 1, linear dolly back S1->S2, backflip with apex slow motion, camera-overtakes ending. Edit and re-run build_blockout_v06.py.

apex_slowmo.note: v06b: world + character clock eases down from start (0.3 s after the jump), holds `rate` (10x slow motion) through the riser, eases back to 1 from release (pause) to end (shunt 3). The camera stays real-time. v06 values were 8.15 / 8.6 / 0.2 / 9.6 / 10.1.

ending.note: camera_dive: CAM_ENDING takes over and dives past him as he brakes (slowdown 41.4). side_view: camera settled side-on at ground level, he is off-screen above. plunge_start: he drops from ~30 m, hitting the platform at slam_speed m/s on the thump (43.8).
